biggest_catch: FPL gets to briefly cycle your enrolled appliances (like your AC) during peak periods — that's the whole deal: automatic monthly credits in exchange for occasional remote cycling.
catches: A qualifying central electric A/C system is required to enroll.
FPL may cycle enrolled appliances during peak demand periods.
Open to homeowners and approved renters.
Credits are automatic monthly bill credits, guaranteed while enrolled.

steps: Confirm you have a qualifying central electric A/C system at your FPL-served address.
Apply for FPL On Call on the official FPL page (homeowner or approved renter).
Let FPL enroll your selected appliances in the program.
Receive automatic monthly bill credits — over $90 a year, guaranteed while you stay enrolled.
